releases.title: Bring your own AI key
added: AI engine tab: connect your own key (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic or Gemini) so compiling is done by a real model
Multi-pass pipeline: analyze, draft, review, refine; Very High runs all four passes
Each result lists the assumptions the compiler made and the details you did not give
Visible warning when the AI engine fails and the built-in engine is used instead
The AI theme generator also uses your own engine
Keys stay in your browser (tab session by default); the server holds them in memory for one job only
changed: Settings drawer renamed from Appearance; the page author tag now follows meta.json
fixed: Per-visitor rate limit now works behind a reverse proxy (all visitors on Render previously shared one limit)
Queue limits: 8 prompts in progress per visitor, 300 waiting in total
Outgoing AI requests are SSRF-guarded: https only, public addresses only, no redirects, size-capped

releases.title: First public release
added: Prompt compiler with four effort levels: Low, Medium, High, Very High
Model-native formatting for Anthropic (XML), Google (Markdown), OpenAI (numbered steps) and open-weight families
Asynchronous queue: finished prompts show instantly while others keep compiling
Claude-style thinking indicator with independently moving dots
Five built-in themes, sandboxed live CSS editor, AI theme generator, .css export and import
Original vs optimized side-by-side view and word-level diff
Tamper-evident authorship seal and What's Changed history
14-day model updater that drafts new model profiles for your approval
models: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Astra
